about.title: About La Rabia
about.intro: La Rabia is a community magazine born in the Uribarri district of Bilbao.
about.body: We are a project of narrative journalism, multimedia experimentation, art and fiction made from the neighbourhood and for the neighbourhood.
We give space to the voices that rarely appear in mainstream media: neighbours, collectives, artists and anyone with something to tell.
We believe in an open, collaborative and local culture. If you want to take part, write to us or pitch a story, we'd love to hear from you.

openspace.form.lead: Tell us what you are proposing. Fields marked * are required.
openspace.form.summaryHint: What it is about, how it came about, why you are sending it to us… in a few lines.
openspace.form.contentHint: Paste it here, attach it as a file, or both.
openspace.form.fileHint: PDF, Word, ODT, TXT or RTF, up to {{mb}} MB.
openspace.form.consent: The text is mine and I agree that the magazine team may read it to consider publishing it.
openspace.form.replyTo: If we select it, we'll write to you at your account's email: {{email}}.
openspace.mine.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw “{{title}}”? It will be deleted, along with its file if it has one.
openspace.mine.title: Your proposals
openspace.how.title: Do you write? Send us your proposal
openspace.how.who: Anyone with an account on the magazine. You don't need to be a member.
openspace.how.what: Poetry, short stories, flash fiction, chronicles, essays… texts written by you.
openspace.how.how: With the form: the title, a short explanation of your proposal and the text, pasted or as a file (PDF, Word, ODT, TXT or RTF).
openspace.how.then: The magazine team reads every proposal. If yours fits, we will write to you to publish it here. You can follow its status on this page.
openspace.cta.signInText: To send a proposal, sign in or create your account. It's free.
admin.proposals.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}”? It will be deleted with its file, and the sender will no longer see it.
admin.proposals.title: Open space proposals
admin.proposals.intro: People with an account on the magazine send them from Open space. Opening a new one marks it as read. The sender sees whether it is received, read, accepted or not selected.
admin.proposals.empty: There are no proposals with this status.
admin.users.complimentaryHelp: A member who pays no fee: the same badge and workshops as a paying member.
admin.users.paidHelp: Pays the membership fee with Stripe.

workshops.editor.mapHint: Search for the address or move the marker. It’s what people will see on the workshop page.
workshops.editor.hostsHint: Who runs the workshop. Its hosts on the team can also edit it and manage the places.
workshops.editor.confirmLeave: You have unsaved changes to the workshop. Leave anyway?
workshops.editor.unauthorized: Only the magazine team can edit workshops.
workshops.editor.mine.backToEditor: Back to the workshop in progress

workshops.editor.membersDesc: Only the magazine’s members (and the team) can book a place.
workshops.editor.freeDesc: Anyone with an account on the magazine can book a place, without being a member.
workshops.manage.inviteHintFree: Anyone with an account on the magazine: the workshop is free. They get a notification to accept or decline.
workshops.editor.dateHint: The date and time appear on the card and on the workshop page. Leave them empty if they aren’t decided yet.
